spell: Lingkar Aksara / Burst (popup hidden: no HUD)
description: Cold open A: night forest path (ts_leuweung), camera zoom 2x, no HUD. Six faceless walk in from both sides; slow-mo, the cursor draws Sunda CA in glowing ink over the Wiku; release: a burst ring erupts and wipes all six.
key_moments: faceless enter from the frame edges
all six gone, rune ring lingers
notes: Enemies are frozen while she draws and slide in slowly under the slow-mo (staged so nothing hits her); they wake 0.8 s after release. Forest is dark green rather than true night; grade darker in the edit if wanted.

description: Cold open B: the Mataram graveyard (mt_kuburan), grey-blue dusk, zoom 2x, no HUD. Six faceless close in; slow-mo, Jawa KA drawn in ink; release: the tide of letters sweeps them away.
notes: Flatter location than A; the Tide effect is less of a single 'boom'. A is the stronger opener.

glyph: sunda_ka (written in light by the intro)
description: The game's own 10 s launch intro: lightning shows Batara Kala's face in the storm, his eyes open, the Wiku on the crag writes Sundanese Ka in light across his face, the storm breaks into dawn, the logo 'Aksara Kala / The script of time' slams in with a beam of light; then the title screen fades up (menu hidden).
key_moments: cut to the Wiku on the crag
logo + tagline in, beam of light
notes: Best logo-reveal material. Recorded with the Music bus muted (the intro's thunder/score lives in music/intro.ogg; re-shoot with --set music=1 if the editor wants it). 1080p.

description: Title screen from its first frame: fade up from night, the logo rises in, 'The script of time', aksara glyphs rising from the Wiku's staff on the cliff; menu and language toggle hidden.
notes: No beam of light here (the beam is in s2_intro). Native 480x270 x4.

description: Wayang prologue card: backlit kelir screen, blencong lamp, Aji Saka's shadow puppet walks on; card 1 'Desa Purwa, dawn...', card 2 'Tonight is the wayang ruwatan...' as the hanacaraka letters appear on the screen.
notes: Simple and static; the puppet is a flat silhouette. Good for the 'ruwatan' line. 1080p.

description: Ruwatan night in Desa Purwa, camera 2x on the wayang stage: the shadows have stepped off the kelir (Buto silhouettes), masked raiders on stage; text 'The shadows step off the screen. Blank masks, reaching hands. People scream; the lamp swings.'
notes: The world is paused while dialogue is up (game behaviour): no motion except text; reads as a held still. Cut from s2_raid.mp4 (native).

description: The Nameless Hunter (portrait): 'Where is the boy with the egg?'
notes: Short, dramatic line. Cut from s2_raid.mp4.

description: The Nameless Hunter: 'Wrong child. A better one.' (just before Laras is taken)
notes: Strongest short line. Cut from s2_raid.mp4.

description: Laras: 'Kak!' then narration 'The lontar tears between your hands and theirs. They drag her into the dark. The lamp goes out.'
notes: The 'Kak!' beat frames the stage roof (scene camera cue), and the lamp going out is told, not shown. Use the text, not the picture.

description: Morning after: the burned kelir and fallen gamelan, embers; 'Morning. Your half of the lontar is gone... Her name on it is fading.' (the village forgetting); last 2 s clean with no text box.
notes: The clean tail (no text) is the best still of the burned stage.

description: Glyph lesson card 'Ka · Bolt' with the Sundanese letter, the ghost stroke guide and the tip; the Wiku traces Ka in the open field (practice), the card's counter goes 0/3 -> 1/3 100%, the bolt fires.
notes: The card sits on the right; the stroke is drawn on the left so both read. 1080p.

description: Daylight meadow, HUD on: three faceless approach from the right; hold, slow-mo, Ka drawn large; 'Ka · Bolt / Perfect' popup; the lightning orb flies into the pack and kills all three.
Six faceless ring the Wiku; slow-mo, Nga drawn; 'Nga · Bind'; vines burst from the ground in a ring and hold and kill the whole ring.
Foes on both sides; slow-mo, Jawa Ra drawn; the orange 'Ra · Summon' card pops; a fire tiger leaps out and hunts the pack while the Wiku stands back.
Accuracy matters: a shaky Ka reads 'Ka · Bolt / Smudged 70%' and the weak orb only staggers a forest jurig; a clean Ka right after reads Perfect and kills it.
notes: Honest: the real recogniser scored the jittered stroke ~0.74 (65-80% band = smudged, 70% power). A fizzle also exists (score below 0.65 fails) but is not in this clip. 1080p.

spell: Burst ring, Summon tiger + staff bolts
description: Tea garden (ts_kebun), HUD on: wave of faceless and tuyul; walk in, three staff bolts, dodge, quick Sunda CA (Ca · Burst), second wave (jurig, boar, faceless), dodge, quick Jawa RA tiger, bolts to finish. 7 foes, all dead.
notes: Energetic but the field is plain grass and the second wave hangs back at the frame edge; the tiger runs partly off frame. 1080p.

glyph: sunda_ka, sunda_nga, sunda_ca, sunda_ga, jawa_ha, jawa_na, jawa_ra, jawa_ka
spell: Bolt, Bind, Burst, Ward, Heal, Dash-strike, Summon, Tide
description: Montage source: eight aksara drawn (0.9 s each) and fired back to back, same framing, three faceless each time. Cut at the key moments (one per glyph, ~2.1 s apart).
notes: One file; each glyph segment starts at its key moment. 1080p.
